subject: general
question: Who among the following won Arjuna Award 2021 in Kabaddi discipline?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sandeep Narwal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sandeep Narwal kabaddi player from Haryana, **received the prestigious **Arjuna award** on** 13th November 2021 by President Ramnath Kovind**.
 
• Sandeep Narwal is the **37th Kabaddi player** to receive the prestigious Arjuna award.
 
• He was born on **5 April 1993 and hails from Sonepat, Haryana.**
 
• Sandeep Narwal was** first selected for the Indian team in the Junior Asians games in 2011**.
 
• He was the latter part of the Indian team tha**t won the Gold medal in the South Asian Games 2016**. 
 
• He was also part of the **Indian kabaddi team who won the Kabaddi World Cup 2016 and Dubai Masters 2018 .**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Narwal made his debut in **VIVO Pro Kabaddi with the Patna Pirates against Bengaluru Bulls.**
 
• Currently, he plays from the team **Delhi Dabangg**.
 
• A total of **35 players was given Arjuna awards**.
 
• **The Arjuna Award**, officially known as Arjuna Awards for Outstanding Performance in Sports and Games, is the second-highest sporting honour in India, the highest being the **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award**.
 
• Both awards were first given in **1961**.

 
 

 Ajay Thakur
 **Ajay Thakur is an Indian professional Kabaddi** player and the former captain of the** Indian National Kabaddi Team. **
 
 

 Jasvir Singh
 **Jasvir Singh** is an Indian professional Kabaddi player. He was a member of the India national kabaddi team that won the **Asian Games Gold medal in 2014 and the World Cup in 2016.**
 
 

 Tejaswini Bai V
 

 **V. Tejeswini Bai is a representative of India in the sport of Kabaddi.** She was a member of the kabaddi team that won a gold medal in the** 2010 Asian Games in Guangzhou.**
